Metadata.title: {brand} — Jobs in Europe for Spanish and Portuguese speakers
Metadata.description: Verified job openings in Germany for Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking candidates. Browsing jobs is always free.

Home.title: Work in Europe, without opaque middlemen
Home.subtitle: {brand} connects Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking candidates with staffing agencies in Central Europe. We start with Germany.
Home.note: Browsing jobs is always free. Candidates are never charged.

meta.title: Job openings in Europe
meta.description: Every verified opening for Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking candidates. Filter by country, sector, language, housing and shift. Browsing is free.

cta.title: Sounds like you?
cta.body: Create your {brand} account, complete your profile, and you can apply as soon as we verify your details.
cta.free: Candidates are never charged. No fees, no subscription.

country.metaDescription: {count, plural, one {# job opening} other {# job openings}} in {place}: warehouse, production and logistics. Many include housing and transport. Browsing is free.

housing.intro: {count, plural, one {# opening includes housing} other {# openings include housing}} in {place}. It's the first question anyone moving abroad asks — answered here.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to complete your profile and apply to jobs.

signup.title: Create account
signup.subtitle: It's free. Candidates are never charged.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent you a link to confirm your account. Open it on this same phone and you can carry on.
checkEmail.spam: If you can't see it, check your spam or promotions folder.

forgot.title: Recover access
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.

consents.terms: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms of Use and Privacy Policy</terms> of {brand}.
consents.dataSharing: I allow {brand} to show my profile to verified staffing agencies.
consents.audio: I allow verified agencies to listen to my English voice recording.
consents.audioHint: This is what lets an agency judge your English without asking for your documents yet. Optional, and you can withdraw it any time from your profile.

messages.resetLinkSent: If that email has an account, the link is already on its way.

errors.birthDate: You need to be at least 16 and enter a valid date.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: You haven't confirmed your email yet. Find our message or request another link.
errors.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists. Try signing in.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Try a longer one.
errors.samePassword: The new password is the same as the old one.
errors.emailRateLimit: We've sent too many emails in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts in a row. Please wait a moment.
errors.linkExpired: That link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.invalidInput: There's something here we can't accept.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.draftIncomplete: Some details are still missing. Go back and check them.
errors.fileMissing: We didn't receive any file. Please try again.
errors.fileTooLarge: That file is too big. Try a lower-quality photo.
errors.fileTypeNotAccepted: That file type doesn't work for this document.
errors.documentTypeUnknown: That document isn't being asked for right now.
errors.documentAlreadyVerified: That document is already approved and can't be changed.
errors.uploadFailed: We couldn't save the file. Please try again.
errors.microphoneDenied: We couldn't use the microphone. You can upload an audio file instead.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

1.title: What's your name?
1.help: Exactly as it appears on your ID document.

2.title: Where are you from, and where are you now?
2.help: Your nationality decides which countries you can work in without a permit.

3.title: English and driving
3.help: This is the first thing an agency looks at. Be honest: it gets checked later.

4.title: What do you need in order to move?
4.help: Many openings include housing or transport. This is how we show you the ones that fit.

5.title: Check before you finish
5.help: You can change any of this later from your profile.

fields.dateOfBirthHint: Agencies only ever see your age, never the date.
fields.englishLevelHint: If you're unsure between two, pick the lower one.
fields.workedInNlDe: I have worked in the Netherlands or Germany before
fields.workedInNlDeHint: It helps, but it isn't required.
fields.needsHousing: I need the job to include housing
fields.needsHousingHint: Not every opening includes it. Ticking this doesn't narrow your options: it helps us sort them.
fields.needsTransport: I need transport to the workplace
fields.needsTransportHint: Useful if you won't have your own car there.
fields.workExperienceHint: Tell us what you've worked in and for how long. Your own words, no format needed.

verificationHelp.unverified: You can already browse every opening. Applying needs your identity verified, and that goes live very soon.
verificationHelp.pending: We're reviewing your documents. We'll email you as soon as we're done.
verificationHelp.verified: Your profile is verified. You can apply to jobs and appear to agencies.
verificationHelp.rejected: We couldn't verify your documents. Check the reason and send them again.

availability.title: Availability
availability.inactiveHelp: You don't appear to any agency. Applications already in progress carry on as normal.

documents.title: Verification
documents.explainer: This is what's needed before you can apply to jobs. You can take the photos with your phone.
documents.lockedWhenVerified: Approved. If you need to change it, get in touch.

rejectionReasons.unreadable: It can't be read: retake the photo with more light and no glare.
rejectionReasons.wrongDocument: This isn't the document we asked for.
rejectionReasons.incomplete: Part of the document is missing: all four corners must be visible.
rejectionReasons.mismatch: The details don't match your profile.
rejectionReasons.other: We can't accept it. Please send it again.

audio.help: Introduce yourself in English for about 30 seconds: your name, where you've worked and what you're looking for. You can redo it as many times as you like.

audioConsent.title: English voice recording
audioConsent.explainer: With your permission, verified agencies can listen to your recording to judge your English. They never hear it next to your last name, email or phone number, and they can't download it.

queue.explainer: Documents waiting to be reviewed, oldest first.

approved.subject: Your {brand} profile is verified
approved.body:
Hi {name},

We've reviewed your documents and your profile is now verified. From now on you can apply to jobs and verified agencies can find you.

Go to your account: {url}

Best,
The {brand} team

rejected.subject: Something's missing in your {brand} documents
rejected.body:
Hi {name},

We've reviewed your documents and we can't verify your profile yet. You can upload them again from your account: {url}

Best,
The {brand} team
